name: Korean K9 Rescue (KK9R)
neighborhoods: Queens/LIC-based; adopts within ~150 miles of NYC (some case-by-case exceptions)
notes: 501(c)(3) No-Kill based in Queens/LIC and Bundang, South Korea. Transports dogs rescued in South Korea plus local at-risk NYC dogs as an approved ACC rescue partner. Foster-based in NYC (dogs live in foster homes until adopted). Thorough screening: requires proper supplies and adopter enrolls in training. Adopts within about 150 miles of NYC (excludes RI and NH); also places in Boston and LA. 3,500+ dogs rehomed. Phone: (no public phone; contact via site) Email: (via site contact form)
type_raw: Rescue+adoption (foster-based, No-Kill) + ACC New Hope partner
